basic_info.description: Incredible opportunity to own a trophy investment property on Union Street in the heart of Cow Hollow. This well-maintained, mixed-use building offers ground floor commercial space with two residential flats above, as well as a detached one-bedroom cottage. The two full-floor flats offer classic Edwardian details, each with two bedrooms, one bathroom, high ceilings, in-unit laundry, hardwood floors and views from the upper unit. A beautiful garden separates the front building and the cottage. The charming one bedroom cottage includes an updated kitchen, bathroom, living room and full basement with laundry and spacious storage area. The cottage will be delivered vacant and would make a lovely pied-a-terre for an owner-user or attractive rental unit for investors. This prime Union Street location is close to both the residential and commercial corridors of the highly desirable Cow Hollow district. Easy access to the Golden Gate Bridge, the Presidio, Fillmore Street, Chestnut Street, shops, restaurants and grocery stores.
